product_name: egg beaters ORIGINAL LIQUID EGG SUBSTITUTE, egg beaters CAGE-FREE ORIGINAL LIQUID EGG SUBSTITUTE, egg beaters CAGE-FREE ORIGINAL FROZEN EGG SUBSTITUTE, Bob Evans Better’n Eggs Made with Real Egg Whites
summary: Cargill Kitchen Solutions is recalling approximately 212,268 pounds of liquid egg products that may contain a cleaning solution with sodium hypochlorite. The health risk is marginal as the use of this product is not expected to cause adverse effects; however, consumers are advised not to consume them and food service establishments should not serve them. Consumers should discard or return these products to the point of sale.
consumer_action: Consumers who purchased these products are urged not to consume them and food service establishments not to serve them. These products should be discarded or returned to the point of sale.
